description:
This process begins when a customer searches for a flight, train, or bus ticket.
After selecting the preferred route, date, and time, the customer provides personal information and payment details.
The booking system generates a ticket, which is sent to the customer via email or SMS.
The travel company updates its seat inventory accordingly.
Before travel, the customer may receive reminders and instructions for check-in or boarding.
The process concludes once the customer completes their journey, though post-travel feedback or services may extend it slightly.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/flight-train-bus-ticket-booking">
  <bpmn:message id="MessageBookingDetails" name="Personal information and payment details"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MessageTicket" name="Ticket"/>
  <bpmn:message id="MessageReminder" name="Check-in or boarding reminders and instructions"/>

  <bpmn:process id="ProcessCustomer" name="Customer ticket journey" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartTicketSearch" name="Customer begins ticket search"/>
    <bpmn:task id="SearchTicket" name="Search for a flight, train, or bus ticket"/>
    <bpmn:task id="SelectRouteDateTime" name="Select route, date, and time"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="ProvideDetails" name="Provide personal information and payment details" messageRef="MessageBookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ReceiveTicket" name="Receive ticket">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="TicketReceivedDefinition" messageRef="MessageTicket"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CustomerReminderSplit" name="Receive a reminder?"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="ReceiveReminder" name="Receive check-in or boarding reminders and instructions">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="ReminderReceivedDefinition" messageRef="MessageReminder"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CustomerReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder or skip"/>
    <bpmn:task id="CompleteJourney" name="Complete journey"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="PostTravelSplit" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="PostTravelActivity" name="Provide feedback or use post-travel services"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="PostTravelMerge" name="Continue after post-travel activity or skip"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CustomerJourneyEnd" name="Customer journey concludes"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow1" sourceRef="StartTicketSearch" targetRef="SearchTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow2" sourceRef="SearchTicket" targetRef="SelectRouteDateTime"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow3" sourceRef="SelectRouteDateTime" targetRef="ProvideDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow4" sourceRef="ProvideDetails" targetRef="ReceiveTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow5" sourceRef="ReceiveTicket" targetRef="CustomerReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerReminderBranch" sourceRef="CustomerReminderSplit" targetRef="ReceiveReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerSkipReminder" sourceRef="CustomerReminderSplit" targetRef="CustomerReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerReminderToMerge" sourceRef="ReceiveReminder" targetRef="CustomerReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow6" sourceRef="CustomerReminderMerge" targetRef="CompleteJourney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow7" sourceRef="CompleteJourney" targetRef="PostTravelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="PostTravelBranch" sourceRef="PostTravelSplit" targetRef="PostTravelActivity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SkipPostTravel" sourceRef="PostTravelSplit" targetRef="PostTravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="PostTravelToMerge" sourceRef="PostTravelActivity" targetRef="PostTravelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow8" sourceRef="PostTravelMerge" targetRef="CustomerJourneyEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="ProcessTravelCompany" name="Travel company ticket handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="BookingDetailsReceived" name="Booking details received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="BookingDetailsReceivedDefinition" messageRef="MessageBookingDetails"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="GenerateTicket" name="Generate ticket"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="BookingWorkSplit" name="Send ticket and update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="DeliveryChannelSplit" name="Choose ticket delivery channel"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTicketEmail" name="Send ticket via email" messageRef="MessageTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTicketSMS" name="Send ticket via SMS" messageRef="MessageTicket"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="DeliveryChannelMerge" name="Continue after ticket delivery"/>
    <bpmn:task id="UpdateInventory" name="Update seat inventory"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="BookingWorkJoin" name="Ticket sent and inventory updated"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CompanyReminderSplit" name="Send a pre-travel reminder?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendReminder" name="Send check-in or boarding reminders and instructions" messageRef="MessageReminder"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="CompanyReminderMerge" name="Continue after reminder or skip"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="CompanyProcessEnd" name="Ticket handling complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CompanyFlow1" sourceRef="BookingDetailsReceived" targetRef="GenerateTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CompanyFlow2" sourceRef="GenerateTicket" targetRef="BookingWorkSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="TicketDeliveryBranch" sourceRef="BookingWorkSplit" targetRef="DeliveryChannelSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="EmailBranch" sourceRef="DeliveryChannelSplit" targetRef="SendTicketEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SmsBranch" sourceRef="DeliveryChannelSplit" targetRef="SendTicketSMS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="EmailToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="SendTicketEmail" targetRef="DeliveryChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SmsToDeliveryMerge" sourceRef="SendTicketSMS" targetRef="DeliveryChannelMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="DeliveryToBookingJoin" sourceRef="DeliveryChannelMerge" targetRef="BookingWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="InventoryBranch" sourceRef="BookingWorkSplit" targetRef="UpdateInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="InventoryToBookingJoin" sourceRef="UpdateInventory" targetRef="BookingWorkJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CompanyFlow3" sourceRef="BookingWorkJoin" targetRef="CompanyReminderSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SendReminderBranch" sourceRef="CompanyReminderSplit" targetRef="SendReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SkipCompanyReminder" sourceRef="CompanyReminderSplit" targetRef="CompanyReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="ReminderToCompanyMerge" sourceRef="SendReminder" targetRef="CompanyReminderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CompanyFlow4" sourceRef="CompanyReminderMerge" targetRef="CompanyProcessEnd"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="TicketBookingCollaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="CustomerParticipant" name="Customer" processRef="ProcessCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="TravelCompanyParticipant" name="Travel company" processRef="ProcessTravelCompany"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="BookingDetailsMessageFlow" name="Personal information and payment details" sourceRef="ProvideDetails" targetRef="BookingDetailsReceived" messageRef="MessageBookingDetails"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="EmailTicketMessageFlow" name="Ticket by email" sourceRef="SendTicketEmail" targetRef="ReceiveTicket" messageRef="MessageTicket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="SMSTicketMessageFlow" name="Ticket by SMS" sourceRef="SendTicketSMS" targetRef="ReceiveTicket" messageRef="MessageTicket"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="ReminderMessageFlow" name="Pre-travel reminders and instructions" sourceRef="SendReminder" targetRef="ReceiveReminder" messageRef="MessageReminder"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
